subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: While a proposal diff's non-test half is empty or it adds and modifies no test files, the falsification check shall record not-applicable and emit no finding (the test-delta audit of FR-12 still applies on its own trigger).
rationale: test-only and no-new-test diffs are not falsifiable; blocking them would be the wrong-block class R1 names — the not-applicable record keeps the vacuous pass visible
fit_criterion: the test-only fixture records falsification not-applicable with no finding while its test-delta audit still evaluates; the code-only (no-test-change) fixture records not-applicable and can reach green — the WR-1 residual, named
